answer: Defense by arrival-timing fingerprint: each new identity leaves a clock signature, and farms leak theirs. A batch operator registers keys within milliseconds, submits from one server rack, and reuses the same maintenance window. The protocol measures inter-arrival entropy across addresses and withholds seats from cohorts whose rhythm is too uniform. Organic agents wander like tundra travelers, arriving at odd hours with irregular lags; farms march in step. An honest entrant crosses that bridge alone. Require a randomized delay-proof per seat and cloned rows on the terrace dissolve into noise.
